project_type: Next.js 16 App Router (React 19) web app inside a pnpm monorepo
build_system: pnpm workspaces. Web app lives at apps/web. Run workspace commands with `pnpm --filter @strata/web <cmd>`. Never cd into apps/web and run `pnpm` directly — always use the filter from the workspace root.
test_framework: No test runner installed. Verification is `tsc --noEmit` + `pnpm --filter @strata/web build`.
verification_instructions: From the workspace root /Users/xuan-manh.trinh/workplace/web/strata run: (1) tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json — expect zero errors; (2) pnpm --filter @strata/web build — expect exit 0.
environment_constraints: Do NOT start the dev server. Do NOT run pnpm install again — it already ran successfully. motion@14 needs to be installed; update apps/web/package.json and run pnpm install from workspace root.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md / CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow conventions in .kiro/steering/development.md and .kiro/steering/tailwind.md.
key_patterns: 1) Import alias @/* maps to apps/web/src/*. 2) All @vkieu/mui/buttons and @vkieu/mui/navigation subpaths are GONE — everything imports from @vkieu/mui. 3) New CSS @theme tokens: text-on-surface (was text-surface-foreground), text-on-surface-variant (was text-surface-variant-foreground), text-on-primary-container (was text-primary-container-foreground). 4) Dark mode: ThemeProvider writes data-mode attribute, not .dark class. 5) cn() utility at @/lib/utils. 6) Steering: .kiro/steering/development.md.
directory_structure: apps/web/src/app/ (Next.js App Router pages and layouts), apps/web/src/components/ (shared components by domain), apps/web/src/features/ (feature modules with sub-components), apps/web/src/hooks/ (custom hooks), apps/web/src/lib/ (utilities, auth, motion, theme helpers), apps/web/src/services/ (API service functions). FEAT artifacts live under apps/web/.agents/tasks/mui-upgrade/ (outside git-tracked src).
